title: Universal Type-I Seed / Field / 3D Smart-Stack Matrix
purpose: Extend the Type-I functional-voxel basis from schematic-equivalent functions into seed-aware 3D embedded smart systems. Compile zero-, single- and multi-seed implementations as directed volumetric region/interface graphs with explicit electric, magnetic, electromagnetic/radiative, optical, thermal, mechanical/acoustic, fluid/pressure, chemical/electrochemical, ionizing-radiation and inertial/environmental coupling.
factorization: Archetype × PrimitiveKernel × VolumetricKernel × InterfaceOperator × ProcessSequence × FunctionalVoxelState × SeedGraph × FieldCoupling × WitnessEvidence

seed_graph_contract.seed_definition: A seed is an inserted discrete component, certified/proprietary element, precision element, active die/device, or other externally fabricated object whose warranted function is not created by the surrounding printed geometry/material process.

classes.name: seedless/material-geometry implementation
classes.rule: All claimed function must arise from qualified printed/deposited/formed materials, geometry, interfaces and process history. Passive R/C/L, antennas, waveguides, heaters, structural/thermal/fluidic functions and some sensors may fit. Active switching, semiconductor gain, certified isolation/protection or precision emitters remain HOLD unless the corresponding printed active/material process is itself separately qualified.

classes.name: single-seed embedded implementation
classes.rule: One inserted seed supplies the irreducible active/certified/precision function; the surrounding 3D stack may provide interconnect, impedance shaping, sensing electrodes, thermal spreading, shielding, antenna/optics, fluid routing, enclosure, service path and identity. Seed package/pads become explicit conductor/thermal/mechanical boundary nodes.

classes.name: multi-seed distributed implementation
classes.rule: Multiple inserted seeds form a coupled network. Compile mutual electrical/EM/thermal/mechanical interactions, clocks/timing, power integrity, fault domains, synchronization, serviceability and common-cause failure paths. Do not approximate as independent single-seed cells when mutual terms are consequential.

seed_graph_contract.external_compute_rule: Delegated Cognigrex/LightSpeed compute is a network service relation, not an onboard seed-equivalence claim.
seed_graph_contract.transition_rule: A design may move SG-N→SG-1→SG-0 only when each removed seed's function is replaced by separately qualified material/process/geometry capability with equivalent acceptance evidence.

transport/Monte-Carlo or measured qualification for consequential space/radiation effects
field_coupling_basis.witness: source/spectrum-bound dosimetry or qualified transport model

spatial_operators.action: place a seed or functional region inside a host volume with explicit clearance, interface and extraction/service path
nest one functional shell/volume inside another without assuming planar Z-order
wrap conductor, dielectric, shield, heater or sensor geometry around a curved/volumetric surface
reserve controlled void/cavity for field shaping, optics, gas/fluid, compliance, thermal isolation or service
create electric/magnetic/RF/optical/ionizing-radiation shielding only to the evidence ceiling of its material and geometry
route fluid, gas, fibre, wire, waveguide or service corridor through the body
vary composition/property spatially with a traceable material/process law
preserve a completed region against later atmosphere/chemistry/temperature/process exposure
establish metrology/datum/coordinate relation between regions and inserted seeds

parasitic_and_coupling_extraction.principle: The schematic supplies intended connectivity; the 3D as-built geometry supplies parasitic and mutual connectivity.

electrical.capacitance: Use closed form only for topology-valid cases. For arbitrary multi-conductor geometry solve/measure Maxwell C matrix; include mutual terms and package/seed pads as conductor nodes.
electrical.inductance: Use topology-valid closed form only where justified; otherwise solve/measure self and mutual L matrix/partial inductance and return-path coupling.
electrical.resistance: Extract volume/sheet/contact resistance from attributable material state and geometry; interfaces/contact resistance are separate elements.
electrical.distributed: Promote to RLGC/transmission-line/full-wave representation when electrical length/frequency invalidates lumped abstraction.

parasitic_and_coupling_extraction.thermal: Build thermal conductance/capacitance network or field model from geometry/material/interfaces; include seed junction/package paths, convection boundaries and radiative view factors when consequential.
parasitic_and_coupling_extraction.mechanical: Assemble mass/stiffness/damping/contact matrices or nonlinear continuum model as regime requires; package/seed masses and compliant interfaces are explicit.
parasitic_and_coupling_extraction.multi_seed: SG-N requires off-diagonal mutual terms where consequential; zeroing mutual C/L/thermal/mechanical coupling requires a justified approximation.
parasitic_and_coupling_extraction.uncertainty: Every inferred matrix retains geometry/material/property/environment source, solver/model revision and uncertainty/sensitivity; measured readback can calibrate but not retroactively validate unrelated regimes.

four_d_state_contract.geometry: G(t) may change through motion, deformation, swelling, wear, phase change or commanded reconfiguration; topology changes require event/state transition, not silent parameter drift.
four_d_state_contract.descriptor: E(x,p,t)*xdot=F(x,u,p,t) is an assembly interface only; child domains retain their governing PDE/ODE/algebraic models.
four_d_state_contract.smart_rule: A smart embedded system exists only when sensed state, deterministic control/safe-state path and actuator/output relation are attributable. Geometry alone does not imply intelligence.

seed_count_examples.capability: passive sensing/harvesting/resonance/heating only within qualified material/process and external interrogation/energy boundaries
seed_count_examples.hold: no autonomous logic/control unless printed active process is separately qualified

seed_count_examples.capability: one inserted seed supplies active function while surrounding printed geometry performs support/passive/field-management functions
seed_count_examples.hold: seed ratings/certification and package parasitics remain exact-instance authority

seed_count_examples.capability: distributed embedded subsystem with explicit mutual coupling, timing, fault domains and network state
seed_count_examples.hold: system safety/reliability/certification requires system-level evidence; component ratings do not automatically compose

engineering_boundaries: 2D schematic symbols are logical intent, not sufficient physical geometry.
3D geometry can create intended passive function and can also create unintended parasitic coupling; both are compiled.
No seed count confers authority. Zero seeds does not imply fully autonomous or semiconductor-capable fabrication.
Capacitance does not establish dielectric strength, leakage, loss, ESR/ESL, lifetime or certification.
RF/optical/thermal/ionizing-radiation models are distinct and must not be conflated.
Near-field and far-field RF behavior must be declared from geometry/frequency regime; do not force a far-field model.
Certified protection/isolation/semiconductor/MEMS/precision optoelectronics remain seed/hybrid unless their full process chain is independently qualified.
Physical execution, release and durable .cgx promotion remain separately gated.

radiative_transport_companion.role: field/radiation/transport regime, source/receiver, energy/passivity and self/mutual-coupling closure across SG-0/SG-1/SG-N
